method: 8 seats; public profile buy-in depths; opens and cold responses use 1000 random deals per persona/size. Original-raiser responses are weighted by that persona choosing to raise; short-stack Britney original-raiser rows are omitted in final probes because she shoves rather than opening to 3 BB. Whole-table probes condition on a non-Britney star opening 3 BB, then the hero reraises to the stated total. They measure whether every opponent folds before any continuation, not complete-hand winnings.
limitations: These are training persona adjustments, not measured real-player fold-to-3-bet frequencies. Fixed probes reuse identical deals for comparisons; complete hands and whole-table holdout use a different seed. No opponent private cards are inputs to policy decisions.
